messages:
Alex Chen: :rotating_light: Heads up — EU-SOUTH2 provisioning lag. Since 09:12 we've seen new GPU allocations stuck in provisioning for gpu-pool-3 and gpu-pool-4. Apparent capacity drop ~30%. Routing is degrading and some requests are queuing. Opening incident.
OpsBot: Alert: provision_timeout detected in eu-south2 (severity: high). Auto-notifications sent to oncall.
Mira Patel: on it. can we shift new reservations to eu-west1? current traffic-shift policy for eu-south2 is manual. need decision on automatic failover.
Samir Gomez: quick debug: nodes show Ready but kubelet failing to accept pods. snippet from infra logs:
```
Apr 05 09:13:02 kubelet[1234]: eviction manager: reclaiming due to disk pressure
Apr 05 09:14:18 cloud-provisioner: timeout provisioning instance i-abc123 (attempt 3)
Apr 05 09:15:10 kubelet[1234]: kubelet: failed to start container: context deadline exceeded
```
Ellie Wang: Customers are seeing elevated latency. Support is getting tickets. We need an ETA and a short status page message.
Jordan (support): Draft status message suggestion: "We are investigating an infrastructure issue in Europe (eu-south2) affecting GPU provisioning and some job queues. Customers may experience higher latency or provisioning failures. We are shifting traffic to alternate regions where capacity is available. We estimate restoration or mitigation within ~2-4 hours; we'll post updates." OK to publish?
Mira Patel: provider-side reports intermittent control-plane API latency. If provider recovers, ~2 hours. If not, full cross-region failover will take ~30-60 minutes to drain and warm caches. There's a cost delta for cross-region burst. Need signoff to increase burst quota. @Terry - EngSRE can you approve?
Terry - EngSRE: approve temporary cross-region burst for mitigation. notify finance and tag billing. Also recommend running our graceful traffic-shift runbook now to avoid long queues. Command to run (ops):
```
/usr/local/bin/traffic-shift --from eu-south2 --to eu-west1 --mode graceful --max-rr=50
```
Samir Gomez: starting a canary shift 10% now to validate. running: 
```
traffic-shift canary --from eu-south2 --to eu-west1 --percent 10
```
OpsBot: Canary shift completed — 10% traffic moved to eu-west1, no errors observed in 5m. :thumbsup:
Jordan (support): Publishing status update now with canary note and ETA 3 hours. Adding recommended mitigations for customers: (1) pin to alternate region, (2) retry/backoff on provisioning errors, (3) contact support for dedicated capacity failover.
Alex Chen: good. please also proactively email any customers with reserved capacity or active scaling policies. coordinate with sales for enterprise customers. keep this channel updated with consumer-facing ETA changes. :white_check_mark:
Mira Patel: I'll continue monitoring provider control-plane and node health, posting logs if anything new. Samir — proceed with gradual shift increments if canary stays healthy.
Samir Gomez: will increment to 30% in 10m if no regressions.
Terry - EngSRE: I'll prep the postmortem template and capture timeline. tagging incident for follow-up.
Alex Chen: thanks everyone. I'll draft the first customer email and share in #support for review before send.
